facts.text: The resort sits within the verdant sanctuary of Mayakoba on the Riviera Maya and is positioned as a wellness retreat.
facts.excerpt: Tucked between the verdant sanctuary of Mayakoba, our Riviera Maya resort is a wellness retreat where luxury design moves in harmony with ancient echoes.

facts.text: Alila Mayakoba is made up of two distinct but connected resort experiences, The Beach and The Lagoon.
facts.excerpt: Alila Mayakoba is defined by two distinct yet seamlessly connected luxury resort experiences.

facts.text: The Beach side has a social, lively mood anchored by a beach club, a taqueria and oceanfront dining.
facts.excerpt: The Beach is Alila's Caribbean expression where the mood is social, vibrant and anchored by a lively beach club, taqueria and oceanfront dining.

facts.text: The Lagoon side is a quieter, nature-led wellness retreat among the mangroves, home to Spa Alila.
facts.excerpt: The Lagoon is Alila at its purest, a nature-led, wellness-focused sanctuary where mangroves, Spa Alila and immersive culinary experiences create a slower, quieter and more intimate retreat.

facts.text: It is the only resort in the Alila portfolio where the beach and lagoon expressions coexist in one place.
facts.excerpt: making Alila Mayakoba the only resort in the Alila portfolio where both expressions coexist in one place.

facts.text: The Beach Front Villa spans two floors with nature-inspired decor and a private terrace with a plunge pool and beachfront views.
facts.excerpt: Get comfortable in two floors of Mayakoba indulgence, with nature-inspired décor and a private terrace with a plunge pool and beachfront views.

facts.text: Beachfront studios offer Caribbean views and a plunge pool on a private balcony or small terrace.
facts.excerpt: Embrace views of the Caribbean from your beachfront studio offering an indulgent plunge pool on a private balcony or small terrace.

facts.text: Lagoon-area rooms with a plunge pool have a balcony with a private plunge pool and views of the lagoon or garden.
facts.excerpt: Find peace on your balcony with a private plunge pool and views of the lagoon or garden.

facts.text: Spa Alila draws on Mayan cosmology and the sacred Tzolk'in calendar.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by Mayan cosmology and guided by the sacred Tzolk’in, we honor the living frequency of time, where every moment offers a unique path to harmony.

facts.text: Wellness spaces include a fitness center with Peloton bikes and an authentic temescal steam lodge.
facts.excerpt: From a fitness center outfitted with Peloton™ bikes to an authentic temescal steam lodge and a spa with treatments grounded in physical, mental and spiritual wellness

facts.text: With traditional healers and spiritual guides, the resort offers cenote immersions, guided ceremonies and energy cleansings rooted in Mayan spirituality.
facts.excerpt: Alongside traditional healers and spiritual guides, we offer destination cenote immersions, guided ceremonies, energy cleansings and more ancestral practices deeply rooted in Mayan spirituality

facts.text: The Earth and Clay ritual uses mineral-rich clay and honey and ends with an ocean immersion.
facts.excerpt: This ritual centers on the application of mineral-rich clay and honey, creating a cocoon of restoration that is amplified by the sun’s warmth and the primal echo of ancient instruments.

facts.text: The off-property Winds of Renewal ritual includes a Mayan water blessing at an open cenote.
facts.excerpt: The trail unfolds into the light of an open cenote for a Mayan water blessing—a communion with the source of all renewal.

facts.text: The resort can arrange snorkeling over coral reefs, private dining on the sand or sailing.
facts.excerpt: Let us craft a coastal moment just for you, whether it’s snorkeling through coral reefs, private dining toes-in-sand or sailing on the blue waves of Mayakoba.

facts.text: Excursions take guests to villages and ancient ruins beyond the resort.
facts.excerpt: Set out from our luxury resort in Riviera Maya and walk among villages and ancient ruins.

facts.text: Casa Amate is a restaurant in a historic lagoon-side house that was once the De Leon family residence, serving Latin American cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Once the residence of the De León family, this historic lagoon-side property now houses a restaurant.

facts.text: Na Cocina Local serves Yucatan cuisine from an open kitchen beside the lagoon.
facts.excerpt: Yucatán cuisine from southeastern Mexico is prepared in an open kitchen, using local ingredients, bright citrus, earthy achiote, and slow-roasted techniques.

facts.text: Alisio Beach Club serves Southern Mediterranean cuisine in a sharing style.
facts.excerpt: Southern Mediterranean cuisine, curated for long lunches and served in a sharing style, sets the tone.

facts.text: El Huerto, the Chef's Atelier, is a home-style kitchen beside an herb garden for hands-on cooking and mixology.
facts.excerpt: A thoughtfully appointed home-style kitchen sits beside a dedicated herb garden, offering an intimate look at Alila Mayakoba’s culinary and beverage story.

facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly and welcomes pets with beds and bowls.
facts.excerpt: We are a pet-friendly hotel, and we welcome your fluffy friends to Riviera Maya with beds and bowls.

facts.text: Cancun International Airport is about 28 miles away.
facts.excerpt: Cancun International Airport (CUN)28 miles

facts.text: Self-parking is complimentary.
facts.excerpt: The hotel offers complimentary self-parking.

facts.text: Mayakoba sits about five miles north of Playa del Carmen.
facts.excerpt: Mayakoba sits about five miles north of Playa del Carmen.

facts.text: Outdoor wellness sessions are subject to weather conditions.
facts.excerpt: Our outdoor sessions are subject to weather conditions.

facts.text: Alila Moments rituals carry an additional cost.
facts.excerpt: **Additional cost** applies

facts.text: Weddings can include a sunset beach ceremony and a reception in the Balam Ballroom.
facts.excerpt: Gather for a beach ceremony at sunset, dine on exquisite locally inspired cuisine or dance the night away in our luxurious Balam Ballroom
